annotations.title: Verify a company in official registers (paid)

description: EU company verification (KYB) from official registers: the global LEI register (GLEIF, incl. Dutch companies with an LEI and their KvK number), France (SIRENE, all companies) and Norway (Enhetsregisteret). Search by name or by LEI, SIREN or organisation number: legal name, active or dissolved, registry id, legal form, registered address, founding date. For B2B onboarding, invoicing, supplier and marketplace seller checks. Costs 0.02 USDC via x402, or 10 credits of a Factline API key.
